scientific_integrity.known_prior_results: The original diagonal-proportional RPCholesky method, its Gibbs power family, its baseline trace bound, and the squared-diagonal Frobenius guarantee are prior results.
scientific_integrity.priority_limit: No independent priority or external audit; equivalent statements outside inspected full texts cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Direct residual Gram positivity, Holder inequality, exact two-block pivot risks and derivative, explicit asymptotic and SPD limiting perturbation.

scientific_limitations: All expected-error claims concern exactly one rank-one partial-Cholesky pivot and trace/nuclear-norm residual error in exact arithmetic.
The dimensional power \(n^{1-1/q}\), not the constant in its universal bound, is proved optimal; the explicit squared-diagonal optimum applies only to orthogonal equal-entry rank-one blocks.
Finite exact-rational verification does not establish real-exponent and unbounded-dimension theorems; those require the analytical arguments.
title: Dimension-sharp trace-error penalty for power-biased Cholesky pivoting
